page: Microsoft Azure F80alds_v7 is a compute-optimized server instance powered by an AMD EPYC 9V45 processor. It features 80 dedicated physical cores running at a clock speed of 4.5 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. The hardware configuration includes 160.0 GB of system memory, providing a resource density of 2.0 GB per core. Additionally, the instance is equipped with 9449 GB of local NVMe SSD storage and supports Premium Storage.

Benchmark results place this server in the top tier (top 10%) for both single-core and multi-core CPU performance via stress-ng, as well as Passmark CPU and memory tests. It demonstrates high memory bandwidth, reaching 14268.72 GB/sec for cached small-block reads and 477.11 GB/sec for uncached large-block reads. Cryptographic and vector processing capabilities are enhanced by hardware support for AVX-512, VAES, and SHA-NI instructions.

The F80alds_v7 is highly optimized for compute-intensive workloads, high-throughput database operations, and local storage-heavy tasks. It achieves top-tier performance in Redis SET operations and static web serving. However, with only 2.0 GB of RAM per core, it presents a memory-capacity tradeoff, making it less suitable for memory-bound applications. It is highly cost-efficient for workloads requiring raw CPU speed and massive local NVMe storage without the overhead of excess memory.
